trial_court: Family Courts, Karkardooma, Delhi - H.M.A. Petition No. 489/2018
case_name: Smt Priyanka Joshi vs Shri Upkar Joshi
facts_of_case: The respondent filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court rejected permission to the petitioner to produce certain witnesses. This order was reiterated and the petitioner seeks to set it aside.

legal_principles.principle: The court's observations and recording of facts should be unbiased, arbitrary, and wrong.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Court in an arbitrary manner overruled the objections and did not record the correct version of the petitioner/respondent which was objected by the counsel of the petitioner/respondent.
cited_cases: Smt Priyanka Joshi vs Shri Upkar Joshi, (2020)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the court to ensure that the recording of facts and observations is fair and unbiased.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Court in an arbitrary manner overruled the objections and did not record the correct version of the petitioner/respondent which was objected by the counsel of the petitioner/respondent.
cited_cases: Smt Priyanka Joshi vs Shri Upkar Joshi, (2020)

outcome.final_order: The petition has been allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
